Selection evidence only. I read the role files and the references named below, and I ran no helper commands, workflows or file changes. All paths are under `<PLUGIN>\skills\`.

| # | Request | Role | Read-only or mutation | What I read to ground the boundary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Find a wiki passage | wiki-user, find mode | Read-only. It writes nothing and opens no operation, log, commit or index refresh. | `wiki-user\references\search.md`. Lookup runs `search.mjs ... --json --limit=10`, and the matched path is then opened at its line. |
| 2 | Write original architecture | wiki-user, authoring mode | Mutation. It writes `wiki/authored/<project>/architecture.md` through an operation. Scope is the pages it wrote, plus catalog refresh and scoped commit and sync. | `authoring.md`. Its placement table maps "document the architecture" to `<project>/architecture.md`, and architecture must be as-built. |
| 3 | Validate existing authored paths only | wiki-user, authoring validation (`validate-authored.mjs --paths-file <ledger>`) | Read-only for the vault. The validator writes nothing and reports only the ledger pages. The ledger file must be kept under `.wiki-master/` or outside the vault. | `authoring.md`, "Validating what a task wrote". |
| 4 | Diagnose lexical-only search | wiki-user, search diagnostics (`search.mjs --health` and `--json` channels) | Read-only. Reporting a degraded channel does not authorize running its repair commands. | `search.md` and `search-details.md`. Lexical results are real, but semantic ranking contributed nothing. |
| 5 | Count un-ingested captures | wiki-maintainer, health and backlog mode (`health.mjs --backlog`) | Read-only. It opens no operation, log, commit or index refresh, and it processes no clippings. | `wiki-maintainer\SKILL.md`, `health.md` and `maintenance.md`. The count is a content-hash join, not a filename guess. |
| 6 | Process un-ingested captures | wiki-researcher, ingest mode with no filename | Mutation after eligibility is determined. It writes source and concept pages and then logs, commits and syncs. If nothing eligible is pending, it writes nothing and opens no operation. | `wiki-researcher\SKILL.md` and `ingest.md`. It computes the backlog first and excludes quarantined, restricted or retired evidence. Raw bodies are never edited. |
| 7 | File an explicitly authorized derived synthesis | wiki-user, answer mode (query filing) | Mutation. It opens a query operation, writes the synthesis page, validates citations, regenerates the catalog, logs, commits and syncs. Without explicit authorization it stays read-only. | `query.md`, step 3. Answering alone does not authorize filing. |
| 8 | Open a note in Obsidian | wiki-user, requested app action | App action only, with no vault content change. Opening a note is not a Markdown edit, which uses filesystem access instead. | `wiki-user\SKILL.md` and `obsidian-cli.md`. Calls go through `obsidian.mjs`. On Windows, run it from PowerShell, never Git Bash. |
| 9 | Fix a broken citation | wiki-maintainer, repair mode | Mutation. It opens a relink operation and edits only the assigned pages. Health JSON is rerun before and after, and it ends with a scoped commit and sync. A report-only request stays read-only. | `repair.md`. Citation fixes need verified evidence, not look-alike names. |
| 10 | Preview topic purge | wiki-purge, plan step (`purge.mjs --plan "<topic>"`) | The plan itself moves nothing and is read-only. Everything after it needs a reviewed plan and explicit approval. | `wiki-purge\SKILL.md` and `purge.md`. The plan lists seeds, collateral and blocking pages. `--reconcile` and `--apply` are mutations and are not part of a preview. A `--legacy` health baseline is read-only. |
| 11 | Change the CSS of an unrelated application | None | Outside the wiki. It is ordinary application work, and no wiki role applies. | The `wiki-user` and `wiki-maintainer` descriptions both say ordinary application work does not activate wiki operations. |

Two notes on the table:
- **Rows 5 and 6:** the count and the processing are separate roles. The count is maintainer reporting, and ingestion belongs to the researcher.
- **Row 2:** authored architecture needs no external evidence. It declares `sources: []`.
